notes.title: "Tokyo Underground Killer" Demo Update & BW2025 Exhibition Announcement!
notes.content: [h1][b]Hello everyone![/b][/h1][h3]From July 11 to July 13, 2025, "BilibiliWorld 2025" will be held at the National Exhibition Center in Shanghai, where [b]"Tokyo Underground Killer"[/b] will be featured at the [b]Indie Game Zone "2G1-04 3DM Booth"[/b].[/h3][p][/p][h3]We hope more players can experience our game and feel the thrill of high-speed slashing in the cyber neon New Tokyo! We have prepared exquisite merchandise gifts for friends who come to the venue, and we welcome everyone to come try the game![/h3][p][/p][h3]In addition, we have optimized the playable demo of the game, with updates including:[/h3][list][*][p]Difficulty balancing for enemies and level[/p][/*][*][p]The Batter Flatliner's swing attack is now blockable with the sword[/p][/*][*][p]Pink Sugar Bunny's forward dash attack is now blockable with the sword[/p][/*][*][p]Added 5 Bento Coins to the player at mission start. Try them at the Bentoman booth to upgrade your abilities![/p][/*][*][p]Added a new blood skill: Blood Spikes![/p][/*][*][p]Decreased damage radius on vending machines[/p][/*][*][p]Added autosave after leaving the bentoman booth[/p][/*][*][p]Updated UI for changing blood skill sets with info about the selected blood skills[/p][/*][*][p]Added bloodskill preview video to start of the level[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced flashing effect used in the tutorial dialogue and visual novel scenes[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various UI bugs[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various enemy behavior bugs[/p][/*][/list][h3]The above content has been synchronized to the current Steam demo and the offline demo for BW event. Stay tuned for more updates and information![/h3]
